audience: teams that track project time in Timicx and want to book hours or run timers with an AI assistant

useCases.title: Book finished time on a project
useCases.text: Find the project and the task. Book a finished time entry with its date, duration in seconds and an optional comment.

useCases.title: Run a live timer for a piece of work
useCases.text: Start a live timer on a project and task. Pause and resume it, then finish it to keep its time as a booking.

useCases.title: Review the hours booked in a date range
useCases.text: List the time bookings of a date range, filtered by employee, project, task or status. Read the duration and billable flag of each booking.

useCases.title: See who runs a timer right now
useCases.text: List the live timers that run or are paused now. Open one to read its employee, project, task and begin time.

useCases.title: Correct or delete a wrong booking
useCases.text: Read a time booking, then change only the fields you give. Delete a wrong booking; the delete cannot be undone.
